venue: Music City Convention Center, Nashville, TN

happyHours.description: End-of-day networking reception on the expo floor. Best 45 minutes for casual conversation and booth visits.

mealTimes.description: Lunch served on the expo floor — use this time to walk booths while competitors are eating.
Final day lunch. Good time to revisit Tier 1 booths and set up post-conference calls.

connectSessions.description: Home Delivery Connect — curated 1:1 meetings between buyers and solution providers. Schedule through the event app.

generalNotes: Conference badge required for all sessions and expo floor access
Session recordings available post-event for registered attendees
Expo floor open both days during session breaks and lunch
Last Mile Retail Awards ceremony held during the event
Event app available for session scheduling and 1:1 meeting requests
